title: Baichuan-M4: A Clinical-Grade Medical Agent System for Continuous Care
title_zh: Baichuan-M4：面向连续照护的临床级医疗 Agent 系统
abstract_en: Baichuan-M4 is Baichuan Intelligence's clinical-grade medical large model, designed for continuous care rather than single-turn medical question answering. It is built as a coordinated medical agent system around three pillars: Baichuan-Harness, a unified runtime that keeps reinforcement-learning training and real-world deployment consistent while enforcing action constraints, tool use, long-term patient memory, and multi-agent coordination; a core reasoning model trained with a continuous-care reinforcement-learning framework that integrates span-level reward modeling (SPAR++), reasoning-path compression, curriculum learning, and stabilized policy optimization; and a clinical tool layer for patient-memory management, authoritative evidence-based retrieval, and multimodal medical perception across documents, X-rays, and dermatology. On a cross-dimensional medical evaluation suite, Baichuan-M4 attains leading results in static medical knowledge and safety, dynamic OSCE-style consultation, long-context clinical memory, evidence-based retrieval, medical document OCR, and multimodal image understanding, while lowering the hallucination rate to 3.3%.
abstract_zh: Baichuan-M4 是 Baichuan Intelligence 提出的临床级医疗大模型，目标从单轮医疗问答扩展到连续照护（continuous care）。系统围绕三大支柱构建：其一是 Baichuan-Harness，作为统一运行时，使强化学习训练与真实部署保持一致，并支持动作约束、工具调用、长期患者记忆和多 Agent 协同；其二是核心推理模型，采用连续照护强化学习框架，结合 span-level reward modeling（SPAR++）、推理路径压缩、课程学习和稳定化策略优化；其三是临床工具层，覆盖患者记忆管理、权威循证检索，以及面向文档、X-ray 和皮肤科图像的多模态医学感知。在跨维度医疗评测套件上，Baichuan-M4 在静态医学知识与安全性、动态 OSCE 式问诊、长上下文临床记忆、循证检索、医学文档 OCR 和多模态图像理解等任务中取得领先表现，并将幻觉率降至 3.3%。
key_points_zh: 论文将医疗大模型定位从单轮问答推进到连续照护，强调长期患者记忆、动态问诊和多轮临床决策能力。
Baichuan-Harness 统一训练与部署运行时，约束模型动作并整合工具使用、患者记忆和多 Agent 协同，降低现实部署中的行为偏差。
核心模型通过连续照护强化学习训练，结合 SPAR++、推理路径压缩、课程学习和稳定化策略优化，以提升临床推理质量与可靠性。
临床工具层支持循证医学检索、患者记忆管理，以及文档 OCR、X-ray、皮肤科图像等多模态医学感知。
在综合医疗评测中，Baichuan-M4 覆盖知识、安全、OSCE 问诊、长上下文记忆、检索和多模态理解等维度，并报告 3.3% 的低幻觉率。

llm_assessment.comment: A comprehensive clinical agent platform combining unified runtime, constrained tool use, long-term memory, multi-agent coordination, and RL training consistency.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是综合性的临床代理平台，结合统一运行时、受约束工具使用、长期记忆、多代理协同和训练部署一致性。
